title: In Silico Identification of Key Genes and Immune Infiltration Characteristics in Epicardial Adipose Tissue from Patients with Coronary Artery Disease
summary: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected TCF21, CDH19, XG and NNAT as coronary-artery-disease-associated genes in epicardial adipose-tissue expression data; associations were checked in two additional GEO datasets. Immune-cell estimates are computational, and no experimental perturbation validates the proposed biology.
